The '''Dravin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Subterrel sector/Legends|Subterrel sector]], a part of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system shared its name with the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] known as the [[Dravin Cut]].<ref name="Deader">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/fiction/triton20080820.html|text="Deader than a Triton Moon"|int=Deader than a Triton Moon|newhost=Suvudu}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Dravin system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square L-20.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
